goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09). The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY this. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept. The old 30M/bs96 config was the previous best run's budget; 10M/384 + optimizations is the committed budget going forward. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~58.7 min (3524s) to 1.8833 BPC @ E40 at OLD locked 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget (budget since recommitted to 10M/384)
current_best.notes: Iter-15 (kernel v23) = window-warmup run. New best 1.8833 BPC. Iter-16 (v24, bigram-hash embedding rec 62) REGRESSED to 1.9049 BPC (hzyupupg, hopeful-tree-15, 3507s) — bigram disabled again in v25. Iter-17 (v25, chunk QK-norm rec 5) ERRORED at build time: QKNormAttention multiplied 4D logits [B*K,H,N,N] by 3D mask [B*K,N,N] (missing head-dim broadcast) — training never started (run kapdvdg0). Iter-18 (v26) fixes the mask broadcast (m->[B*K,1,N,N]) and re-runs the QK-norm architecture. Iter-19 (v27) recommits the compute budget to 10M chars / block 512 / stride 256 / bs384 (+ warmup 150, steps_per_execution 16, vectorized datasets, timing logs) — the first run at the new committed budget. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 (d1024/40ep, bs256) -> 2.2597 (bs512@10M) -> 1.8869 (30M chars, bs512) -> 1.8833 (window-warmup) -> [1.9049 bigram regression] -> [v25 QK-norm build ERROR].

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.
